Grandma's Rustic Sourdough Boule:
- 450g unbleached strong bread flour
- 360g filtered water (80% hydration)
- 90g active sourdough starter at peak (20%)
- 10g fine sea salt (2.2%)
Method: 1 hour autolyse, 4 sets of stretch-and-folds spaced 30 minutes apart, 5 hours bulk fermentation at 24C, overnight cold retard in banneton at 4C. Bake in preheated cast iron Dutch oven at 230C with lid on for 20 minutes, then lid off at 210C for 22 minutes until deep mahogany crust.
